title: How has the current Joz world-model implementation been validated?
summary: Local engineering validation passed; production accuracy awaits sufficient real shadow trajectories.
body: The latest reported local validation passed 20 frontend tests, 27 world-model tests, the production build, Joz LLM checks, the Joz quality gate, dataset export and evaluation fixtures, syntax checks and diff checks. Evaluation reported zero guardrail violations, but production prediction accuracy is not yet claimed because real trajectory volume remains insufficient.

claims: Local engineering validation passed; production accuracy awaits sufficient real shadow trajectories.
